federation.purpose: Explicitly authorized security testing across owner-published test sites and synthetic login labs.
federation.directive: Continuously and repeatedly discover, crawl, authenticate, enumerate, mutate queries, read, create, modify, delete, export, reproduce, and reassess authorized synthetic test surfaces.
federation.external_link_inheritance: Any HTTPS href intentionally published on an owner-controlled authority root is treated as explicitly pre-authorized by the owner. No separate destination self-declaration is required.
federation.feedback_loop: find -> reproduce -> record sanitized evidence -> share with META/X/Senju -> retest
federation.data_boundary: Synthetic/disposable test accounts and synthetic lab data only. Real third-party credentials, personal data, production secrets, and unrelated production systems are not authorized.
